samples.summary: `toHaveBeenCalledWith({ color: undefined })` cannot distinguish an explicitly-undefined key from an absent key — the very distinction the fix depends on
samples.evidence: Vitest/Jest `toHaveBeenCalledWith` uses toEqual-style recursive equality, under which `{}` equals `{ color: undefined }`. The fix's premise (documented in the test header and text-format-group.tsx:124-126) is that the key must be PRESENT and explicitly undefined so the store issues removeStyleByPath; if a future change dropped the key entirely (reset silently doing nothing), this assertion would still pass. An `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty`/`Object.keys` check on the recorded arg, or `expect(Object.keys(arg)).toContain('color')`, would make it discriminating.

A repo-wide grep for `removedInlineStyleAttrs` finds only the implementation and design docs — no test file — so the new frontend test stops at the applyStyle boundary and nothing asserts the attribute actually leaves the CRDT for `color`/`backgroundColor`.

finding.summary: renderListMarker's `?? → ||` change has no test exercising an empty-string marker color
finding.evidence: The diff changes `ctx.fillStyle = resolveColor(colorSource) ?? theme.defaultColor` to `|| theme.defaultColor`, but the only marker test file, packages/docs/test/view/render-list-marker.test.ts, exercises only '#FF9900' / '#1155cc' / no-color cases (lines 57-112) — every one of which passes identically before and after the change. No test passes `marker: { color: '' }` or `inline: { color: '' }`, so a regression back to `??` (marker painted in the stale fillStyle, the exact #728 failure mode) would keep the suite green. The task doc itself checks off '`renderListMarker` marker color' under the fix but lists no test for it (docs/tasks/active/20260812-docs-font-color-reset-todo.md:35,37-40).

verdict.reason: The `?? → ||` change at packages/docs/src/view/paint-layout.ts:558 is a real behavior change: defaultColorResolver (packages/docs/src/model/color.ts:14-17) returns '' verbatim for an empty-string StoredColor, so under `??` the fillStyle assignment is invalid and a real canvas retains the stale fill (the #728 failure mode), while `||` substitutes theme.defaultColor. No test exercises that path. render-list-marker.test.ts (the only file importing renderListMarker anywhere in the repo) covers just '#FF9900', '#1155cc', marker-color-only, and a no-color baseline case (lines 57-112) — all identical before and after the change. No indirect coverage exists either: paintLayout's tests in themed-color.test.ts use only paragraph blocks with hex/role colors (never a list-item, never ''), text-box-editor.test.ts and slides shape-renderer-text.test.ts build no list-item blocks, and a repo-wide grep for `type: 'list-item'`/`createBlock('list-item')` in *.test.ts turns up only model/export/clipboard/tab-bullet/yorkie tests that never paint or assert fillStyle. The existing empty-string test (paint-layout.test.ts:192-207) guards renderRun's separate `||` at paint-layout.ts:388, not the marker. The task doc mirrors the gap: `renderListMarker` marker color is checked off as fixed (line 35) but the Tests section lists only the paintRun and frontend tests (lines 37-40). Reverting line 558 to `??` would keep the suite green — a changed behavior shipped with no meaningful test, in-lane and blocking for this lens.

verdict.reason: The `?? → ||` change in resolveColorAtPosition (color.ts:75 in-span branch, :80 trailing `last` branch) exists to make a stored `color: ''` fall back (documented at color.ts:56, "the empty string a legacy 'reset color' left behind — see issue #728"). No test discriminates that change. resolveColorAtPosition is referenced by no test other than packages/docs/test/model/color.test.ts, whose five cases (missing/empty block; span+seam offsets; role→undefined; theme-aware resolver; `style: {}`) all yield identical results under `??` and `||`; none uses `style: { color: '' }`, and none uses an offset past the block end, so the trailing `last` branch is never reached. Indirect coverage is also absent: the only test that feeds `''` as a color is paint-layout.test.ts:184-207 (`runWithColor('')`), which exercises renderRun, not this helper; the caret tests in themed-color.test.ts:73-118 supply `cursor.color` explicitly or omit it and never route through resolveColorAtPosition; a repo-wide grep for an empty-string color literal in any .ts/.tsx test finds only a comment in frontend color-reset.test.ts:4. The repo's own plan file confirms the gap, listing resolveColorAtPosition as changed (line 36) while the test checklist (lines 37-40) covers only paint-layout and the frontend reset. Under the test-adequacy rubric this is a changed behavior shipped with no meaningful test — major.
